Existing dev2 analyzer hardcodes variant names, dev2 roots, and older eta names; adapt root and eta/provenance validation explicitly. Keep learned-metric and ImageReward PNG paths identical, finite metrics, unique prompt IDs, exact counts.
Frozen rule remains IR delta>0 and full-res MUSIQ delta>0 and CLIP delta>=-0.3; at most two selected by IR then MUSIQ then name. Preserve all three outcomes; no tuning on heldout.

Repeated reuse of eight development prompts can overfit selection. Existing heldout has already informed project continuation at a campaign level, so further reports must disclose adaptive reuse; an untouched test split is needed for a strong final efficacy claim.

RMS matching preserves squared multiplier average, not guaranteed attention entropy or output distribution. Latent input may differ after the first step between methods, so record per-trajectory official gain and final gain for verification.
